title: Defer Three.js until visible 3D demand
summary: Deferred the Three.js capability until a graph shell intersects the viewport, while explicit graph navigation still hydrates correctly. Initial script transfer fell from 489079 to 358081 bytes and normal hydration from about 788 to 370 ms; the remaining compressed initial-JS target miss is isolated to the main entry.
